about: Observed results for the synthetic pages in this folder. They document what the existing page scripts do (including their defects) and what the prototype extractor returns. They say nothing about real provider pages.
engine: WebKit: WKWebView, 1000 x 700 CSS px, not attached to a window, macOS 27.2.1. Not run in Chromium.

howEachBlockWasProduced.appleScripts: capture-scripts/live-*.js driven by a loop that mirrors apple/SessionVault/WebCapture.swift:146-186 and :102-116, sleeps included.
howEachBlockWasProduced.appleSnapshot: The frame-growing logic of WebCapture.swift:120-142 followed by WKWebView.createPDF.
howEachBlockWasProduced.applePipeline: The appleScripts turns passed to the unmodified looksLikeSignInWall and fromCapturedTurns of apple/SessionVault/Importers.swift, with the fake source URL shown and the title precedence of ImportSheet.swift:134-138 (no typed name). When looksLikeSignInWall is true the Apple app saves nothing; the other fields show what it would have saved without that guard.
howEachBlockWasProduced.referenceEngine: The verbatim body of capture-scripts/reference-capture-engine.js via callAsyncJavaScript.
howEachBlockWasProduced.pullerEmulation: NOT a run of pull_sessions.py: its Python logic (lines 70-95, 123, 134-182) restated in page JavaScript around the four verbatim puller-*.js function texts.
howEachBlockWasProduced.prototype: capture-scripts/proposed/web-extractor.prototype.js with the defaults of capture-selectors.draft.json and the strategy order of the named provider entry.

textNormalisation: Every text below was normalised: split on newlines, collapse runs of spaces, tabs and no-break spaces to one space, trim each line, drop empty lines, join with newlines. Apply the same function before comparing, because innerText differs slightly between browser engines. Indentation inside code is therefore not visible here.
roleLegend: U = user, A = assistant, N = none (Apple role 'unknown', shown as 'Note')
lists: Lists of more than six turns are given as turnCount, firstTurns (two) and lastTurn. A text longer than 600 characters is cut to its first 300 and last 120 characters with a marker in between. applePipeline message texts are the saved texts as they are (not normalised).

What can I put in a compost bin, and what should stay out of it? I have a small garden and a closed plastic bin.
Vegetable scraps, fruit peel, leaves, grass cuttings and coffee grounds all work well. Keep out meat, dairy and cooked food, because they attract pests. Mix green and brown material in roughly equal parts and turn the heap every two weeks. EXAMPLE answer.
How long until it is ready?
